title: Swiss Mobile Banking Platform
description: Denis Korinšek’s Android engineering and leadership on a shared mobile banking platform serving 100+ Swiss banks, at G+D Netcetera since November 2023.
lede: Android feature development for a shared mobile banking platform serving 100+ Swiss banks, combining reusable platform functionality with bank-specific customizations.

meta.role: Senior Android Developer · Team Lead · Line Manager

technical: Developed card-management, account and transaction features, contributing to architectural decisions, business logic and banking service integrations.
Designed and implemented secure WebView integrations with deep-link handling and security controls.
Contributed to the gradual migration from XML to Jetpack Compose, developing new Compose screens and reusable UI components.
Designed and implemented functionality for managing multiple banking contracts and accounts, accessing contracts across devices and managing registered devices.
leadership: Lead Android development and feature delivery for the platform, covering shared functionality and client-specific requirements.
Guide technical decisions, conduct code reviews, resolve complex issues and keep engineering quality high.
Coordinate delivery priorities, address technical blockers and work directly with clients and distributed engineering teams across Slovenia, Switzerland, Austria and North Macedonia.
note: This summary covers my own role and responsibilities, not the product as a whole.
